day_line: A mountain on a Monkey day. Solid and quick: good for steady work and clever fixes, easy to get restless.

lines.Yang Wood: Monday opens a door. Volunteer for the new project, then ask for the timeline.
lines.Yin Wood: Steady choices pay today. Bring lunch from home and log the expenses.
lines.Yang Fire: You lift the Monday mood. Bring snacks to the meeting; keep it short.
lines.Yin Fire: Your point is clear today. Say it once in the meeting; write it down after.
lines.Yang Earth: Your team is solid today. Divide the work early and lunch together.
lines.Yin Earth: Someone pitches a similar idea today. Join forces; two names look good.
lines.Yang Metal: A smart fix comes to you today. Test it on one file before you roll it out.
lines.Yin Metal: Someone covers for you today. Thank them in person, not by email.
lines.Yang Water: Monday piles it on a bit. List three things, finish two, forgive the third.
lines.Yin Water: Your careful work gets noticed today. Take the credit; don't pass it on.
